messages:
ajay: Quick thread to lock a tiny playbook for post-launch triage. We keep hitting the decision stall: do we patch, schedule, or archive? I propose a 3-lane flow + minimal ticket checklist so reviewers can decide fast.

maya: yes please. we need deterministic rules and owners. otherwise PRs sit in review forever.

courtney: sketch:
- Lane A (patch): production-impacting regressions, data loss, or single-customer blocker -> immediate patch sprint (owners + canary)
- Lane B (next-wave): high-value UX/perf issues that need >1 dev day but <1 sprint -> planned in next sprint with acceptance metric
- Lane C (backlog): polish, feature asks, long research -> groom and schedule in roadmap cycles

courtney: also enforce: if ticket is regression -> auto-escalate one lane upwards.

ben: Add small checklist to each ticket: severity, regression-flag (yes/no), owner, estimated dev-days, rollout plan (canary/rollback), acceptance metric. If any fields missing, auto-assign to "triage" with a 24h SLA for owner fill-in.

ajay: I like that. For rollout plan make a tiny template:
````
Canary slot: date/time
Smoke script: path/to/script.sh
Rollback criterion: observed error rate >1% for 15m OR p95 latency +200ms
````

sara: I'll own smoke scripts and the rollout checklist. Can we standardize the canary window label so release tooling can auto-reserve? Suggest tag `postlaunch/canary`.

release-bot: Canary window helper: when PRs include label `postlaunch/canary` and a `canary-window` timestamp in PR body, I will reply with reservation details. Next available slot: 2026-05-12 08:00-09:00 UTC.

oliver: For next-wave items, agree on a "fast-win" flag for <=3 dev-days. Fast-wins can be pulled into the immediate follow-up sprint if capacity allows. Research >3d gets a 3-day spike and decision gate.

dena: CS ask: we need a short customer ETA template when we pick Lane A or fast-wins. I'll draft one if you want.

maya: please do. final ops: i'll add the checklist columns to the backlog sheet and mark owners for top 8 items. Owners, please update your ticket with the checklist by EOD or it goes to triage queue. If anyone disagrees on lane assignment call it out in-thread within 2 hours.

ajay: will update my two tickets. flagging one (profile corruption) as Lane A now.

courtney: i'll add an acceptance metric field to the UI/perf tickets.

ben: i'll draft the rollback runbook and attach to the DB-affecting tickets.

maya: thanks team  this should speed up routing and reduce debate overhead. :rocket:
